name: agent-orb
description: Records what your Claude Code agents do (tools, tokens, models, delegations) and sends it to your own agent-orb server

stallMinutes.title: Stall alert (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: Flag a tool, or a silent agent mid-turn, after this many minutes

modelCeiling.title: Model ceiling
modelCeiling.description: Agents with no model of their own (general-purpose, workflow agents, model: inherit) are flagged above this; off turns that part off

content.title: Content
content.description: off: metadata only. full: also prompts, answers, thinking where shared, tool input and output, masked and capped

excludeProjects.title: Never send content for
excludeProjects.description: Comma-separated repo names, owner/repo, or paths: these projects stay metadata-only
